name: Honey Soy Turkey, Cabbage & Mushroom Stir-Fry with Soba Noodles

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fill another large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Once the water is boiling, add soba noodles and cook until tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and rinse in a colander; set aside.
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the cabbage.
Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cabbage and mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 7-8 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, juice limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, honey, pepper, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, return turkey to the pot along with drained noodles and sauce. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
